name: sap-clm
_readme: SAP Customer Loyalty Management (CLM) as a TARGET only: SAP's public-cloud SaaS loyalty engine on SAP BTP (GA Q4 2025, continuous cloud delivery, docs version SHIP). Built for estimating a greenfield loyalty introduction (incl. B2B / indirect-channel scenarios) and as the knowledge of the standard critic standard-sap-clm. No as_source block and no adapter.py: there is no customer code base to scan. Facts verified 2026-10-05 against help.sap.com (content service), the api.sap.com OData catalog, news.sap.com and the licensed composable storefront registry - see reference-cache.md; open points are *(verify)* in research-seed.md. Scope decision: SAP CLM only - SAP Emarsys Loyalty is a different product and not covered here.

as_target.api_name: SAP Customer Loyalty Management APIs (Checkout Connect, Wallet Connect, Backend Services, Data Products)
as_target.default_frontend: none for members - CLM ships an administration UI only; every member-facing screen (balance, history, rewards, redemption, pay with points) is built in the storefront or app against the CLM APIs

snippets.critic2_persona: seasoned SAP loyalty solution architect who has delivered SAP Customer Loyalty Management since its Q4 2025 general availability, earlier SAP loyalty engines, and B2B commerce on SAP Commerce Cloud with the composable storefront and an ERP back end; deliberately sceptical about 'standard' claims for a young cloud product and above all for B2B: accepts a capability as standard only when a current help.sap.com page (read through the content service) or the api.sap.com catalog shows it for SAP Customer Loyalty Management itself, reads SAP News announcements as intent rather than shipped scope, and knows that the documented member model is one person per wallet
snippets.docs_domains: help.sap.com - SAP Customer Loyalty Management, product key Customer_Loyalty_Management, version SHIP (About, Feature Scope Description, User Guide, Admin Guide, Integration, APIs, Security Guide, What's New Viewer, Onboarding). The portal is a JavaScript application that answers HTTP 200 for any URL: read topics only through its content service with the sap-commerce pack tool `python3 <plugin>/knowledge/platforms/sap-commerce/tools/saphelp.py <topic-url>` (`dbcx plugin-root` prints <plugin>); `dbcx safe_web --url` prints the raw page shell, whereas the quote gate (`dbcx evidence quotes`) reads help.sap.com through the content service itself. Search the portal with `python3 <plugin>/knowledge/platforms/sap-commerce/tools/sapsearch.py "<query>" Customer_Loyalty_Management`. api.sap.com - SAP Business Accelerator Hub, package sap-clm-SAPCustomerLoyaltyManagement with the REST APIs Checkout Connect, Wallet Connect, Backend Services and Data Products (all 1.0.0-beta); it is a single-page app the quote gate cannot read, its public OData catalog service gives package and API metadata, the OpenAPI specifications need an SAP login. news.sap.com for SAP's official positioning and quarterly release recaps (an announcement states intent, not shipped scope). Partner and analyst sites are not evidence of product scope.
snippets.best_practice: CLM is the system of record for wallets, points cards, tiers, rewards and the loyalty ledger; storefront, ERP and service tools are event sources and display channels and never compute balances themselves. Earn from a business event that will not be undone lightly (order confirmed, delivered or invoiced - decide which per channel) and send it with a stable reference of the source document (order or invoice number as requestor action reference) so every loyalty transaction stays reconcilable and a resend cannot double-book; model returns, cancellations and credit notes as explicit debits that reference the original document (no dedicated reversal type is documented) and align the 'Postponed' spending delay with the return window. Decide the wallet key strategy before the first integration (which identifier is the customer id, which further keys - card number, ERP contact number, login id), because every channel must resolve to the same wallet or duplicates appear. Map member brands to sales organisations and partner brands to business partners from day one, so the ledger book records carry the finance keys. Treat the two workspaces as non-production and production, script or document every business object (promotions, journeys, rewards, brands) because nothing is promotable between workspaces, and set the program owner's primary currency before moving to Live. Put integration logic (mapping, retries, idempotency, monitoring) into an integration layer such as SAP Integration Suite, never into the storefront; use OAuth client credentials through SAP Cloud Identity Services. Implement personal-data deletion yourself - CLM never deletes wallets on its own.
snippets.critic2_focus: Score every 'covered-standard' against the CLM documentation of the current SHIP version, not against announcements, partner pages or other SAP loyalty products. B2B: the only wallet type selectable today is 'Consumers', a wallet is one person, a group wallet pools persons (one group per member) - a company-level account, a buying-organisation hierarchy, company-level tiers, earning on the company's invoices or via a wholesaler/distributor channel, and a split between purchaser and beneficiary are NOT documented; such requirements are configuration plus custom integration logic or a gap, never standard. Earn path: documented are base earn per currency unit of the member brand, promotions and journeys, and basket submission through Checkout Connect - insist that the analyst names the source event and the API. Pending/returns: 'Postponed' is a fixed day count, there is no documented return or reversal transaction type. Finance: the ledger is append-only double-entry and 'passed to SAP S/4HANA', but the only documented S/4HANA integration is master data INTO CLM - financial posting or accrual is custom (verify) unless SAP documentation shows otherwise. Integrations: only S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition (master data) and SAP Service Cloud V2 (mashup) are documented; SAP Commerce Cloud, composable storefront, SAP Customer Data Cloud, SAP Customer Data Platform and SAP Emarsys have no documented CLM integration - each is a custom integration. APIs: all four are 1.0.0-beta; operation names and paths must come from the api.sap.com specification of the day. Environments: two workspaces per subscription, no configuration promotion - double configuration effort is real, not optional.
snippets.expected_hotspots_d3: B2B membership: company/account-level loyalty (the documented model is one consumer wallet per person; wallet type 'Consumers' only), several buyers of one company collecting into one balance (group wallet pools persons, one group per member, not a company account), company hierarchies and roles. Indirect channel: earning on purchases made through wholesalers/distributors (sell-through data, purchase claims, receipt or invoice upload) - no receipt/claim handling is documented. Earn basis: invoice- or delivery-based earning, product-category multipliers, minimum order values, B2B net prices and currencies. Returns, cancellations, credit notes and partial returns after points were spent (no reversal type documented). Tier logic: automatic qualification and requalification periods (documented: thresholds plus periodic evaluation by staff, status points from journeys). Rewards: physical premiums, vouchers of partners, merchandise fulfilment (documented rewards are discount codes from the rewards bank). Member UI in the storefront or app (no shipped member UI, no composable storefront loyalty library). Identity linkage to the storefront login and to an existing CIAM. Financial accrual/posting to the ERP. Marketing communication (CLM sends none). Fraud and duplicate-account checks beyond the documented earning/spending/gifting/goodwill limits and key statuses.
snippets.expected_blockers_d4: No documented company-level (B2B) wallet; no documented SAP Commerce Cloud / composable storefront, SAP Customer Data Cloud, SAP Customer Data Platform or SAP Emarsys integration; all public APIs in beta (1.0.0-beta); no documented event/webhook interface (the Business Accelerator Hub lists REST APIs only); no documented return/reversal transaction type; master-data ingestion from S/4HANA on a system-controlled schedule, invalid records dropped; no configuration promotion between workspaces; Live irreversible without Support and primary currency immutable after Live; API rate limits and payload limits not published
snippets.content_model_notes: CLM has no CMS and no member-facing UI components: its own UI is the administration application (workspaces, programs, brands, wallets, promotions, journeys, rewards bank, ledger exports) for business users and service agents. Reward and promotion content (name, description, media asset) is maintained in CLM; everything a member sees is rendered by the storefront or app from Wallet Connect / Checkout Connect responses. On SAP Commerce Cloud with the composable storefront there is no loyalty library in the licensed @spartacus scope (release 221121.18.0) - every loyalty screen (my points, history, tier status, rewards, redeem, pay with points at checkout, enrolment and consent) is a custom component plus a backend integration, never a mapped standard component.
snippets.api_families_hint: see knowledge target_api_endpoint_families: four REST APIs on SAP Business Accelerator Hub (package sap-clm-SAPCustomerLoyaltyManagement), all version 1.0.0-beta - Checkout Connect (offers and discount codes at checkout, redemption settlement, basket submission for post-sales processing), Wallet Connect (wallet and identity, clubs, benefits, cards), Backend Services (wallet processes, card adjustments, club management, engagement triggers), Data Products (master data import, resource access, transaction processing, transaction exports under /admin/dataproducts/v1/...). Authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials through SAP Cloud Identity Services app-to-app (machine-to-machine only). Documented paths are few (wallet delete, export runs, the S/4HANA replication endpoints); every other operation name or path must be read from the current api.sap.com specification before it is quoted. No event or webhook interface is documented.
snippets.effort_rules: Effort profile for SAP Customer Loyalty Management (greenfield). (1) Tenant and landscape: BTP sub-account subscription, SAP for Me provisioning, SAP Cloud Identity Services trust, two workspaces (non-production, production), regions, currencies, admin users and roles - small, but it is set-up work, not zero. (2) Programme configuration in the admin UI: brand units with sales-organisation / business-partner keys, identity and consent schema, wallet keys, points program (earn rate, rounding, postponed spending, expiry, negative balance, limits), tiers, clubs, rewards bank, code formats, promotions and journeys - configuration effort per object, done TWICE because business objects cannot be promoted between workspaces; count the second workspace and its test as real effort. (3) Rules beyond the documented mechanisms (company-level aggregation, invoice- or sell-through-based earning, category multipliers outside promotions, automatic tier requalification, return clawback) are custom logic in an integration layer or a side service - size them as development, never as configuration. (4) Integration per source system is custom: each channel (webshop orders, ERP orders/invoices/credit notes, POS, distributor sell-through data) needs mapping, identity resolution to the wallet, idempotent submission, error handling, reconciliation and monitoring; the only prebuilt content is S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition master data replication (configuration of DRF, RFC destination, OAuth) and the SAP Service Cloud V2 wallet mashup. (5) Financial posting / accruals to the ERP: not documented as a standard integration - custom on top of the ledger exports or APIs until SAP documents it (verify). (6) Member UI in the storefront: custom components and a backend facade (composable storefront has no loyalty library) - enrolment, balance and history, tier status, rewards and redemption, pay with points in checkout. (7) Identity: linking the storefront/CIAM identity to the wallet key is custom. (8) Beta APIs: estimate against the published beta specification and record the assumption; a breaking change before GA is a change request, not a hidden buffer. (9) Data migration of existing balances or members, if any, is its own position.
snippets.scope_editions: Single cloud product SAP Customer Loyalty Management on SAP BTP (no on-premise or private-cloud edition documented); subscription includes two workspaces; licensed consumption metered across workspaces against one entitlement (Billable flag on loyalty transactions); price metric and tiers not public (verify with SAP); data centres North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific per workspace.
snippets.b2b_fit: Documented: per-person consumer wallets (wallet type 'Consumers' is the only choice at workspace creation, the tile already shows a B2C/B2B wallet type), group wallets pooling persons, multi-brand member and partner brands with booking/redemption settlement, POS/eCommerce checkout API. Not documented: company or account wallet, organisation hierarchy, purchaser vs beneficiary, invoice-based or distributor/wholesaler sell-through earning, receipt or claim upload, B2B pricing context. Treat every company-level requirement as custom or gap and record the assumption.
snippets.pitfalls: Workspace Live is one-way (Support needed to go back) and freezes foundational settings such as the primary currency; nothing is promotable between workspaces; one wallet per person per workspace - choose wallet keys carefully or duplicates appear; club points can be earned but not spent and Pay with Points works only on the main program; segment ingestion overwrites a segment with the same external reference without warning; S/4HANA master data ingestion runs on a system-controlled schedule and drops invalid records; daily ledger exports cover the previous day (not real time); CLM deletes no personal data by itself; consent texts live outside CLM; all APIs are 1.0.0-beta; no documented events/webhooks, rate limits or reversal type.
